headline: Thailand and Canada pilot mobile carbon capture in the cement industry
summary: The Thai Cement Manufacturers Association, with Canadian partners including the Government of Saskatchewan and the University of Regina, will install a Mobile Carbon Capture Unit at a cement plant in the Saraburi “sandbox” to build technological readiness toward Thailand’s 2050 Net Zero Cement and Concrete Roadmap.
co2crc_note: Cross-border cement-CCS technology transfer in APAC — a template for capturing emissions from a hard-to-abate industry, relevant to CO2CRC’s regional engagement.

headline: PayPal backs emerging carbon removal technologies in its latest climate investment strategy
summary: PayPal said its latest climate investment strategy will support emerging carbon dioxide removal (CDR) technologies, adding a new corporate buyer to the durable-removal market; no purchase volume or dollar figure was disclosed.
co2crc_note: Signals continued growth in corporate CDR demand; tangential to CO2CRC’s geological-storage focus.
extractor_note: No purchase volume or dollar figure stated; corporate strategy announcement.

headline: Entropy commissions Glacier co-generation + CCS project, Alberta
summary: Entropy Inc. commissioned Phase 2 of its Glacier project in Alberta — a 15 MW gas-turbine co-generation unit with integrated post-combustion capture across 45 MW of generation, expected to sequester about 192,000 tonnes of CO2 a year; billed as the first post-combustion CCS on a gas turbine for power.
co2crc_note: Benchmark for post-combustion CCS retrofitted onto gas-fired power generation.
extractor_note: Radar item — commissioned 30 Jul, outside the 3–4 Aug window; surfaced as near-miss context.
